newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt, Yemen sign oil and gas protocol.
newsitem.headline: Egypt, Yemen sign oil and gas protocol.

text.p: Egypt and Yemen have signed a protocol agreement to increase technical cooperation in oil and natural gas, an Egypt oil ministry official said on Wednesday.
Yemeni Oil Minister Mohammad Said al-Attar, who arrived in Cairo on Monday for a three-day visit to Egypt, signed the agreement with his Egyptian counterpart, Hamdi el-Banbi.
An Egyptian delegation held similar talks in Yemen earlier in the year.

"It is a protocol for the broad lines of cooperation in the fields concerning exploration and Egypt's specialised companies in engineering, pipelines, construction, and training fields," the official said.
